body.zh-Hant: 西蒙是海地總統（1908至1911年）。參考百科記他推翻了皮埃爾·諾爾-亞歷克西（Pierre Nord-Alexis），並說他是繼利西烏斯·薩洛蒙（Lysius Salomon）之後第一位坐上總統職位的黑人。他來自海地南部，未受過教育，對平民與民間文化懷有真切的同情，因此帶有民粹色彩。
body.en: Simon was president of Haiti from 1908 to 1911. The reference entry says he overthrew Pierre Nord-Alexis and was the first black man since Lysius Salomon to hold the presidency. He came from southern Haiti, was uneducated, and felt real sympathy for common folk and folk culture, which gave him populist qualities.

citations.quote: president of Haiti (1908–1911)
Simon overthrew Pierre Nord-Alexis
became the first black since Lysius Salomon to occupy the president's chair
From southern Haiti, uneducated
with real sympathy for common folk and folk culture
Simon exhibited populist qualities

heading.en: Foreign capital and the railroad contract

body.zh-Hant: 條目指出，美國資本利益日增，成為他政府的負擔。紐約的城市銀行（City Bank）為麥克唐納合約提供資金，該合約授予詹姆斯·麥克唐納（James P. McDonald）興建從太子港到海地角的鐵路。北部農村的卡科人（cacos）對此特別不滿。德國與法國資本家同樣活躍於海地經濟。
body.en: The entry says growing U.S. capitalist interests burdened his administration. The City Bank of New York financed the McDonald contract, which gave James P. McDonald grants to build a railroad from Port-au-Prince to Cap Haitien. The rural cacos of northern Haiti were especially irked by it. German and French capitalists were also active in the Haitian economy.

body.en: The entry says Simon's oppression of mulattoes, arbitrary arrests of protesting schoolteachers, and the mass slaughter of a caco town in northeastern Haiti focused foreign scorn on him. The entry records that in August 1911 he went into exile.

body.zh-Hant: 蒙特於1849年生於聖地牙哥，是前總統曼努埃爾·蒙特·托雷斯（Manuel Montt Torres）之子。他先就讀國立學院（Instituto Nacional），再進入智利大學，並在1870年1月取得律師資格。德國國家圖書館權威檔也記他生於1849年，並記他生於聖地牙哥。
body.en: Montt was born in Santiago in 1849, the son of former president Manuel Montt Torres. He studied at the Instituto Nacional and then the University of Chile, and qualified as a lawyer in January 1870. The German National Library authority record also gives 1849 as his year of birth and Santiago as his birthplace.

citations.quote: Nació el 29 de junio de 1849, en Santiago.

body.zh-Hant: 蒙特1876年當選佩托爾卡的候補眾議員。1883年他身為佩托爾卡選區眾議員，創立國會圖書館並出任首任館長。他在巴爾馬塞達政府下擔任工業與公共工程部長（1887年6月28日至1888年4月12日），又任財政部長（1889年10月23日至1890年1月21日），後因與總統意見不合而離職。內戰後，他在豪爾赫·蒙特政府下兩度出任內政部長（1891年12月31日至1892年3月14日，及1893年4月22日至1894年4月26日）。
body.en: Montt was elected substitute deputy for Petorca in 1876. In 1883, while deputy for Petorca, he founded the National Congress Library and became its first director. Under Balmaceda he served as minister of Industry and Public Works (28 June 1887 to 12 April 1888) and as finance minister (23 October 1889 to 21 January 1890), leaving after disagreements with the president. After the civil war he twice served as interior minister under Jorge Montt (31 December 1891 to 14 March 1892, and 22 April 1893 to 26 April 1894).

heading.zh-Hant: 參議員、總統候選與當選

body.zh-Hant: 蒙特在1898年7月2日起出任眾議院議長，1900年當選考廷（Cautín）參議員，1906年再當選聖地牙哥參議員。他在1901年參選總統但敗給赫爾曼·里埃斯科（Germán Riesco Errázuriz）；1906年6月25日的總統選舉中他當選，並於1906年9月18日就任總統。
body.en: Montt presided over the Chamber of Deputies from 2 July 1898, was elected senator for Cautín in 1900, and was re-elected as senator for Santiago in 1906. He ran for president in 1901 but was defeated by Germán Riesco Errázuriz; he was elected in the presidential election of 25 June 1906 and took office as president on 18 September 1906.

citations.quote: Presidió la Cámara entre el 2 de julio de 1898 al 2 de junio de 1899
En 1900, fue electo senador por Cautín
En 1906, fue relecto senador esta vez por Santiago
Se presentó como candidato presidencial para las elecciones de 1901
siendo derrotado por Germán Riesco Errázuriz
elecciones presidenciales del 25 de junio de 1906, donde resultó electo
Asumió como Presidente de la República el 18 de septiembre de 1906.

body.zh-Hant: 蒙特上任時正逢瓦爾帕萊索大地震後，他必須投入重建與救助，並面對嚴重的經濟危機。政府擴建鐵路網，也設立了美術學校與博物館等機構。1907年12月，硝石工人聚集在伊基克（Iquique）的聖瑪利亞學校，局勢極度緊張；21日部隊以機槍展開攻擊，此事成為智利工人運動史上的里程碑。他因健康原因於1910年7月前往歐洲，於同年8月16日在德國不來梅去世，任期未滿。
body.en: Montt took office just after the Valparaíso earthquake and had to devote himself to reconstruction and relief while facing a serious economic crisis. His government extended the railway network and created institutions such as the School and Museum of Fine Arts. In December 1907 saltpetre workers gathered in the Santa María school in Iquique and tension peaked; on the 21st troops opened fire with machine guns, events that marked a milestone in the history of the Chilean labour movement. For medical reasons he sailed for Europe in July 1910 and died in Bremen, Germany, on 16 August of that year, before his term ended.

body.zh-Hant: 據桑德斯《蒙古歷史辭典》，布姆策恩德早年曾在庫倫（烏爾加）當勞工，之後回到家鄉的和碩從事地方行政工作。巴登的《蒙古現代史》則稱他是游擊軍隊的前軍官，1920年代曾任警察首長，但評價上不算傑出的人物。
body.en: According to Sanders's Historical Dictionary of Mongolia, Bumtsend worked as a laborer in Urga and then returned to his home hoshuu to work in the local administration. Bawden's The Modern History of Mongolia calls him a former officer of the partisan army and a police chief in the 1920s, though not an outstanding personality.

heading.zh-Hant: 1940年出任小呼拉爾主席團主席
heading.en: Chairman of the Little Khural presidium, 1940

body.zh-Hant: 桑德斯記載，1940年蒙古人民革命黨第十次大會選他進入中央委員會主席團，第八屆大呼拉爾並於1940年7月6日選他為小呼拉爾主席。桑德斯的年表將此職標為國家元首。布朗與翁努的專書稱他由第八屆大呼拉爾選出；俄文專書的片段則記載，小呼拉爾主席團方面，布姆策恩德是依喬巴山的提議選出的。
body.en: Sanders records that in 1940 the party's tenth congress elected Bumtsend to the presidium of the Central Committee and the eighth Great Khural elected him chairman of the Little Khural on 6 July 1940. Sanders's chronology marks the post as head of state. Brown and Onon say he was elected by the eighth Great Khural, and a snippet of a Russian study records that, for the Little Khural presidium, Bumtsend was chosen on Choibalsan's proposal.

body.zh-Hant: 桑德斯記載，布姆策恩德在1951年當選人民大呼拉爾主席團主席（國家元首）。桑德斯的歷任主席名錄列出他任職自1940年7月6日至1953年9月23日，並稱他在任內去世。布朗與翁努的專書也寫他（1881至1953年）後來擔任重要的黨政職務，包括大呼拉爾主席團主席。
body.en: Sanders records that Bumtsend was elected chairman of the presidium of the People's Great Khural (head of state) in 1951. Sanders's list of chairmen gives his term as 6 July 1940 to 23 September 1953 and says he died in office. Brown and Onon likewise note that he (1881-1953) later held important Party and Government positions, including Chairman of the Presidium of the Great Khural.
